 News oi-Pooja Jaiswar By Pooja Jaiswar 
 Updated: Wednesday, November 4, 2026, 19:48 [IST]
 Add as a preferred source on Google Punjab state has declared its usual Dear 50 Buster, Wednesday lottery result on November 4, 2026. The first prize will get Rs 21 lakh. The lucky draw went live at 6:30 pm from Camp Office, Ludhiana, in Punjab. In total, there are seven prizes offered under the Dear 50 Buster lottery, ranging from as low as Rs 100 to Rs 21 lakh. There are no consolation prizes.

How To Claim Punjab Bumper Lottery Prizes?
 If your lottery winning amount is below Rs 10,000, then you can claim the amount at any designated retailer or lottery shop in Punjab. But if the winning amount is between Rs 10,000 to Rs 1 lakh, you have to submit the lucky winning ticket at the Punjab State Lottery Office. For winning prizes above Rs 1 lakh, you will be required to submit the lottery ticket at Directorate of Lotteries (Punjab Govt.).
 Ensure to submit the tickets within 30-90 days of the winning. There are certain documents that you will need to submit along with your lottery ticket. These are:
 - Original winning ticket (Signed on reverse).
 - Photocopy of Aadhaar card/ other government ID.
 - Passport-size photos.
 - Bank account information (copy of passbook or cheque cancelled).
 Notably, waiting too long to claim the winning amount may spoil your prize.
